metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the reckoning, the candle already lit, the muddy hem, and St Luke.

yesterday: Thursday filled three galleries. That is the whole of the news.
Heminges and Bryan will wait within the week. Who signs is still the widow's accounts.
The hall candle was lit at five. It is the firing sixpence. Upstairs light is yours.
The hem has Shoreditch mud on it. The jaw is tender.
